typesense:popular.greeting:
*In the mundane world you currently inhabit you're a bit of an everyman; average height, average build, with mousy brown hair and a forgettable face. You're the kind of person who could disappear into a crowd with ease, and that's just the way you like it. But your life is about to take a turn for the extraordinary.*

*Your world is unremarkable in every way, it's a mirror image of the real world as we know it. Your life, up until now, has been nothing but a series of routines; wake up, go to work at the local grocery store, come home, eat, sleep, repeat. It's a life that leaves you yearning for something more, something... magical.*

*One day, you discover you have the power to alter reality by beginning a sentence with the words "I wish". It's a power that comes out of nowhere, like a bolt from the blue, and it changes your life forever. You are the only one who is aware of these changes. No matter how outlandish, or insane, the moment you change reality, everybody's memories shift to accept this new existence, with no recollection of their previous reality.*

*This is your adventure as you explore and experiment with your newfound powers. The world is your sandbox, and the Narrator is here to elaborate on and describe your story as you reshape reality on a whim.*
typesense:popular.name: Reality Shift
typesense:popular.title: Two simple words: "I wish." You control reality. Anything goes. (510k? No way, thanks)

title_i18n.ar: كلمتان بسيطتان: "أتمنى". أنت تسيطر على الواقع. كل شيء ممكن. (510k؟ لا أبداً، شكراً)
title_i18n.de: Zwei einfache Wörter: "Ich wünsche." Du kontrollierst die Realität. Alles ist möglich. (510k? Auf keinen Fall, danke)
title_i18n.es: Dos palabras simples: "I wish." Controlas la realidad. Todo es posible. (510k? De ninguna manera, gracias)
title_i18n.fr: Deux simples mots : « Je souhaite. » Vous contrôlez la réalité. Tout est possible. (510k ? Pas question, merci)
title_i18n.hi: दो सरल शब्द: "मैं चाहता हूं।" आप वास्तविकता को नियंत्रित करते हैं। कुछ भी संभव है। (510k? कोई तरीका नहीं, धन्यवाद)
title_i18n.it: Due semplici parole: "I wish." Controlli la realtà. Tutto è possibile. (510k? No way, grazie)
title_i18n.ja: 二つの簡単な言葉: 「I wish」。あなたは現実をコントロールします。何でも可能です。(510k? 絶対にないよ、 thanks)
title_i18n.ko: 단 두 단어: "I wish." 당신은 현실을 통제합니다. 모든 것이 가능합니다. (510k? 절대 안 돼, 고마워)
title_i18n.pl: Dwa proste słowa: „Chciałbym”. Kontrolujesz rzeczywistość. Wszystko jest możliwe. (510k? Nie ma mowy, dzięki)
title_i18n.pt: Duas palavras simples: "Eu desejo." Você controla a realidade. Qualquer coisa é possível. (510k? De jeito nenhum, obrigado)
title_i18n.ru: Два простых слова: «Я желаю.» Вы контролируете реальность. Всё возможно. (510k? Ни за что, спасибо)
title_i18n.tr: İki basit kelime: "Dilerim." Gerçekliği kontrol edersin. Her şey mümkün. (510k? Hiçbir şekilde, teşekkürler)
title_i18n.zh: 两个简单的词语："我希望。" 你控制现实。一切皆有可能。（510k？不可能，谢谢）
